notes.title: Map editor and custom lobbies
notes.content:
Hey fellow racers,

with this major update we mainly released our map editor! You can build your very own cube racer 2 maps now. And since that isn't enough for us, there is even more:

Map Editor
There is a map editor now!!! The map editor is not built into the game, it is a separate software. You can find the editor and all available instructions on our webpage Map Editor installation

Server Browser/Lobby Rework
With the help of Moto, we reorganized the whole menu of lobbies and queueing for games. There are now four distinct modes to play the game:

Quick match (If you just want to be matched onto a public server with other random players)
Custom game (Create your own custom game. There you can change all settings like map, amount of rounds etc.)
Server browser (See all running servers, and choose where you want to join. Can also be used to join the custom lobbies of friends)
Splitscreen (As usual)


Custom lobbies

If you create a custom lobby through the main menu, you can change a lot of game settings. These include maximum players, amount of rounds, team race, skills, skill boxes, gravity, building credits, building time, ban obstacles and set the current map.
If other people queue through quick match, they won’t get matched onto custom servers. So custom games need to be joined through the server browser.
Custom games are also needed to play maps created with the map editor. Only there you can select the custom maps you have subscribed to in the steam workshop. Other players should not need to have subscribed to these maps prior to joining the server, since the game will dynamically download the needed maps through steam.


Voting
The voting processed is now integrated into the UI. The initiation of votes is now done through the escape menu. All voting options can be selected and started there. The voting process itself is also integrated into the UI now. In the top left screen, a little panel is shown, showing the current vote and offering the option to vote yes or no with F5 and F6.

General changes/updates

It might sound unbelievable, but yes, you can look up and down now when using mouse movement
On the lowest graphics quality settings, the weather particles are now disabled to improve performance.
We tried to prevent the savegame files corruption bug from occurring, but since I wasn’t able to identify the problem completely, there is only a workaround built in now, which might repair the corrupted files itself, but since it isn’t possible to reliably reproduce the bug, it hasn’t been tested yet.
The pipe stuck check has been improved, to further prevent people from getting stuck inside of pipes
The elo should now only be affected, if a player took part in at least three rounds. Since this hasn’t been tested as well, it might only take two rounds. If you have feedback about that, leave it on the discord, so we can further improve this.
The angled pipe has been improved and should not cause the game to lag on all clients anymore. This was not fully tested as well, so it remains to be seen, whether this works as expected :)


Obstacles

All obstacles were reorganized into six categories instead of four. The new categories are more inspired by the purpose of obstacles, rather then trying to classify the type of the obstacle. This should make finding a certain obstacle more intuitive and improve the building experience. There are also new icons for all six categories.
The bottom bar of the building menu has been increased in width, so there is no need to scroll now in any category. For now… ;)
Magnets have been balanced. The range is now reduced from 40 to 25, and the strength was reduced from 50000 to 37500.


Tutorial
One wall of the tutorial contains a little gap now. This requires new players to hold only SPACE and nothing else, in order to be able to climb that wall.

Guys, have fun!

notes.title: First post-release patch
notes.content:
This is the first patch, fixing some issues which we encountered in the first amazing week after release!

Kill Log

We updated the kill logs appearing on the right screen side. Now if some players already reached the goal, the kill logs no longer overlap with their playernames


Horns & Spamming

We had some few players, who made good use of honking the sh*** out of their horns :D Although this is kinda funny, we wanted to do something about it, in consideration of the mental health of our players. So now as soon as a player reaches the goal, he cannot honk anymore
And further we added the mute function. By entering /mute in the chat window, you can mute a specific player. Then you won't see any of his chat messages, and you won't hear him honking anymore.


Steam invites

It was possible, to break people's steam client by inviting them ~1000 times per second. This should not be possible anymore, thanks to a little invite colldown :)


Maps

We fixed the start boxes of many maps. It was possible, to bulid black holes or magnets very close to the start. So players got sucked or pulled or even died due to deadly obstacles, which were placed very near to the starting box. This should now not be possible anymore


Weather

We reduced the brightness of the sun in some weather settings, since it was blooming all over the place. Let us know, if you are still being blinded, then we reduce that even more ;)


Player Level

We increased the maximum player level, since some players have already reached the previous maximum level. Now this shouldn't be a problem anymore for a long time ;D



We're now working on some more bigger fixes and content, so stay tuned, and happy chaos :)

notes.title: We've got a release date: 09.03.2022
notes.content:
It's time!

On March 9th we will finally release Cube Racer 2! We've gathered a ton of feedback in the last couple of months in our alpha testing phase. The game is now more polished than any player can hope for, while still providing the most satisfying chaos possible.

If you want to sneak peek the game, try out the still available demo version, and if you like this masterpiece of a game, we will greatly apprieciate you whishlisting the game. Also tell your friends about it, play with them, and let them whishlist it as well. We want to see our servers burn on release date...

Although we're nearing the release date, leave us any feedback and comments you have, either on our development discord or in the community page here. We read everything, promise!

See you no later than 9th March in the most chaotic but cleanest release ever.

Cheers

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Welcome to this summer update v0.166

We've been working on this big update the last couple of weeks, and just released it with some fixes today. It introduces the new gamemode called "Skill Boxes", where you play with collectable skills every round. Below you can find the complete changelog for this update

New gamemode: Skillboxes

At every checkpoint, 4 skillboxes spawn and can be collected, dropping a random skill for the player
The gamemode can be voted to active, or you can now queue with the desired gamemode settings (See below)


Gamemode settings in lobby

Before you queue, you can now select all gamemode settings you want to play with
If no matching server is found, you will be put into an empty server, with all the gamemode settings you entered


Ingame

When all players are stuck at the same position, a skillbox with an explode skill will spawn at the last checkpoint after 3 minutes. One player can use it, to blow up the difficult part
When a player uses his skill, an animation will pop up on the left side of the screen for all the players to see
Added explode skill (finally)
When spectating a player, your camera now follows the camera of the spectated player
Added free-cam mode when spectating players
While you are frozen, you cannot use any skills


Obstacles

New obstacle: Magnet
New upgrade obstacle for Portal
New upgrade obstacle for Wrecking Ball
New upgrade obstacle to Axe
The strong button trap version was made more expensive, from 13 to 27
When a player gets pushed off the track, or boosted into something deadly, the touched obstacles no longer give helpfull points, but instead will be counted as deadly points


Maps

Added new map with built-in funnel and summersault


Skins & Horns

Added 4 new horns
Added a new skin
New season pass has been added

notes.title: Special events during Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

as part of our participation in the Steam Next Fest, we have three disctinct ingame events for Cube Racer 2. They will start and end according to our schedule below, so keep in mind to play at the given times to try them out.

Wrecking Ball Madness
17.06 (1pm UTC) - 18.06 (1pm UTC)
In this event, two random players can each build one wrecking ball onto the track in the first round of the game. This makes it all so more chaotic and interesting during the last four rounds.

Sewers
19.06 (1pm UTC) - 20.06 (11pm UTC)
During this event, pipes are unlocked for all players, and they are absolutely cheap, causing a loooot of pipes through the map and obstacles.

Mini Wrecking Ball Event
21.06 (1pm UTC) - 22.06 (1pm UTC)
In this event, the wrecking balls are unlocked for everybody, but they are very tiny and fast swinging, because they slipped into a shrinking machine, obviously.

Keep an eye out for these events, and feel free to tell us which one you enjoyed the most. See you during Next Fest!

notes.title: Wrecking Ball Event - v0.160
notes.content:
Welcome to v0.160,

apart from all the changes listed below, we have something special in store for you. Starting this Monday evening at 2pm (UTC) of May 24th, there will be a Special Wrecking Ball Event! The event lasts for 24 hours, but don't worry, it will be back again, alternating with different events throughout the weeks.

The Wrecking Ball Event will allow two random players to build a free wrecking ball after the first round. So each round will have at least two wrecking balls somewhere on the map, if the players decide to build it (Who wouldn't?) Get ready, and here are the changes:

Changes:

New skins, including the famos seagul skin
Added disco weather, yeah, for real
Private games can now be queued with a self picked room code
Players who don't reach the goal at all don't receive any points for position in finish and height in goal
Added /extend command, to vote for an extension of one more round
Added special wrecking ball event


Fixes:


The tip cube doesn't show, as long as the obstacle upgrade shop is open
Fixed '@' symbol in podest screen
Inputs are now blocked when chatting, so no accidental resetting is happening
Reduced the brightness on some maps and weathers


See you on Monday I suppose, and please leave some feedback on the special events, and if you have an idea for an event, drop it!

notes.title: Testing Monday - v0.158
notes.content:
Good morning,

This update concludes all our changes of the last couple of weeks, which includes all the preparation for our big testing week in mid June, and also a lot of improvements based on our active community. All detailed changes, fixes and new features can also be found in detail in older devlogs, so here are the major changes summarized:

New:


Console-Commands to change gamemode, teamrace, skills and kick inactive players
10-minute timer, which ends a round, if no one reaches any more checkpoints
A lot of new skins and horns
4 new maps, and a lot lot lot of new environment objects. Look out for flowers, mushrooms and more
Mouse movement has been added


And of course, so much more bug fixes and little improvements in all corners. We also improved the performance of our servers, which should now be able to handle up to 48 players during this testing phase, distributed over four game servers.

With all these changes, see you in the world of our tropical cubes, where you can forget all about your problems, and generate new ones to replace them ;)
